name: hxn-gpu-webgpu
description: WebGPU for Haxe in the browser, on hxcpp and Ash compiled to wasm: devices, buffers, textures, bind groups, pipelines and command encoders
releasenote: Instance.claimCanvas: under Ash the browser agent takes the web page's canvas when the program claims it, not when it starts, so the page can carry other browser agents, such as WebGL2's.
